# Tests — Composite (C#)

*Generated by Claude Opus 5 (claude-opus-5) — Created on 2026-08-04*

For further enquiry please contact Akin Kaldiroglu at akin@kaldiroglu.dev

## Type

**Unit tests** (xUnit 2.9, net10.0). No I/O, no timing, no external resources — the suite is
deterministic and runs in milliseconds.

## Scope

| Class | Covers |
|-------|--------|
| `Gof/GraphicsCompositeTests` | Leaf and composite share one type; composites nest; a leaf rejects the child operations the Component declares |
| `Gof/EquipmentCompositeTests` | `NetPrice`, `Power` and `DiscountPrice` roll up through cabinet → chassis → bus → card |
| `Bom/RollUpTests` | Cost, weight and part count at every level of the bicycle |
| `Bom/StructureTests` | Sharing, quantity on the edge, duplicate lines, cycle rejection, uniform traversal |
| `Bom/CacheInvalidationTests` | Memoized roll-ups, and invalidation upward through **every** parent |
| `Bom/ExtensibilityTests` | A new Leaf kind (`Service`) absorbed with no other edits |
| `Bom/NaiveBomTests` | That the naive design **works**, then each of the five things it costs |
| `Bom/DesignComparisonTests` | Both designs give identical answers; 85 child entries against 13 |
| `Drawing/CanvasTests` | Shape counts roll up; a canvas holds a canvas; a leaf has no `AddGraphic` to call |
| `FileSystem/DirectoryTests` | A directory cannot hold itself or an ancestor; `Add` takes the child from its old parent; the disk report prints 167,816 and 45,000 |
| `Hw/OrgChartTests` | The roll-up includes the manager; a shared report is silently counted twice; cycles refused |
| `Hw/SurveyFormTests` | Validation concatenates rather than sums; `Add` on a `Question` compiles and throws |
| `Hw/ExpressionTests` | The tree evaluates by recursion; a number substitutes for a sub-expression; divide-by-zero refuses |

## Results

```
Passed!  - Failed: 0, Passed: 73, Skipped: 0, Total: 73 - Composite.Tests.dll (net10.0)
```

The 49 GoF and bill-of-materials tests are the same assertions, with the same expected
values, as the Java suite. The remaining 18 cover the areas Java tests by demo only.

## Run it with

```bash
dotnet test
dotnet test --filter DesignComparisonTests
dotnet test --filter NaiveBomTests
```
